visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Multiple cats of various colors—including orange, tabby, and bicolor—are sitting or lying on a light wood-plank floor in a modern kitchen and dining area. A green plush dinosaur toy lies near a tabby cat in the foreground. The camera pans across the room, showing a clean environment with minimalist furniture, chairs, and a white pet water dispenser. (2) The camera zooms in on a small, dark insect lying motionless on the light-colored floor. A person's hand enters the frame from the side, pointing an index finger directly at the dead mosquito on the floor. The lighting is bright and consistent with indoor household lighting. (3) A scene transition introduces a young boy with dark, messy hair sitting at a light wooden table. He is wearing a yellow t-shirt and using a small fork to eat what appears to be a white piece of food. He looks toward the camera while talking and chewing. (4) In the present, the person's hand is shown again, now holding the tiny dead mosquito on the tip of a finger. A grey tabby cat approaches the hand, its face coming into close-up as it sniffs the dead insect curiously. (5) The video ends with a full-screen graphic featuring a large cartoon mosquito next to a tombstone with 'RIP' text. Two traditional paper-doll figures and stacks of canned cat food are arranged in the background against a bright yellow and green backdrop, styled like a memorial altar.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A playful, rhythmic background music with staccato pizzicato strings and a light percussive beat begins. A man's voice, energetic and curious, speaks in Mandarin, questioning what the various cats in the room are looking at. The speech rate is moderate with natural conversational pauses. (2) As the camera focuses on the mosquito on the floor, the man's vocal intensity increases dramatically. He lets out a sharp gasp followed by a high-pitched, exaggerated shout of 'Xiao An An!'. The music continues, but the vocal arousal is now very high, conveying mock tragedy. (3) The audio shifts to a domestic room recording in a flashback. A young child's high-pitched, innocent voice is prominent as he discusses naming a mosquito 'Xiao An An'. Background noises include soft swallowing sounds and minor room resonance. The man's voice is heard at a lower volume, responding calmly. (4) Return to the present-day audio layer. The man's voice is now extremely loud and strained, wailing the mosquito's name with long, falling intonations mimicking heavy crying. The original playful BGM persists underneath this high-arousal comedic vocal performance. (5) A hard cut in the audio leads to a somber, elegiac musical piece. It features a synthesized flute melody over slow, sustained minor-key chords. The tempo is very slow, and there are no vocals, successfully creating a mock-serious funeral atmosphere for the end of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Discovery -> Contextual Flashback -> Comedic Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A humorous storytelling video that uses domestic cats and a family memory to create a mock-tragic narrative. It connects a present-day discovery of a dead mosquito to a past moment where the owner's son had affectionately named the insect, culminating in an over-the-top comedic memorial.
